message.content:
Cremation urns of cast aluminum are classified by CBP in 7616.99 (other articles of aluminum), or in 8306.29 (statuettes and other ornaments of base metal). Several CBP rulings on decorative cremation urns have gone to 7616.99.5090. However, some rulings put urns in 8306.29 as ornaments. Typically, for cast aluminum urns, CBP has used 7616.99.5090 (other articles of aluminum, other, other), since the urns are principally containers for ashes rather than ornaments. Cast articles in 7616.99.10 are "Other: Castings, not machined", so this heading requires "cast, not further worked." These urns are hand-finished and decorated, so they fall outside that subheading. The correct code is 7616.99.5090.
